items.title: Avakian George — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: But I thought, Peter Nero. This has all the sophistication that you connect with Bette Davis and show people and so forth, and it worked beautifully.

ctx.x: Yeah, Petah. Bette Davis had told me that she never did a movie in her life in which there was anybody named Peter, but this is the thing everybody picked up on. But I thought, Peter Nero. This has all the sophistication that you connect with Bette Davis and show people and so forth, and it worked beautifully. So, end of story.
